## Context / Problem

`.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml:68-184,397` invokes external actions in a workflow with contents/actions-write and OIDC capability. Existing actionlint covers all workflows, but `Makefile` does not require zizmor to inspect this credentialed workflow and the focused pin contract covers only release workflow behavior.

## Approach

Replace every non-relative/external `uses:` reference in `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml`—including `actions/checkout`, `actions/setup-python`, and `actions/cache`, as well as third-party actions—with an exact 40-hex commit SHA followed by a readable version comment. Edit `Makefile` so `ZIZMOR_WORKFLOWS` unconditionally includes `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml`. Extend `tests/unit/test_release_workflow_pins.py` (or its renamed focused successor) by reading each complete external `uses:` line, not its existing whitespace-truncated `uses:\s*(\S+)` token. Match the complete line against `uses:\s*\S+@([0-9a-f]{40})\s+#\s+[^\n]+$`, thereby proving both the SHA and its trailing readable version comment.

## Scope

- `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml`
- `Makefile` — add the workflow to `ZIZMOR_WORKFLOWS`.
- `tests/unit/test_release_workflow_pins.py` — parse complete external `uses:` lines and enforce the full-SHA-plus-readable-version-comment contract.

## Testing

Run the focused pin test with three negative controls: a mutable tag, a bare SHA without a comment, and a SHA followed by a comment that the whitespace-token extractor would otherwise discard. Run the existing `make lint` actionlint/zizmor path and confirm zizmor receives the reconciliation workflow.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Every external `uses:` reference in `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml`, including first-party `actions/*`, has an exact 40-hex SHA followed by a readable version comment.
      Verified: `grep -n "uses:" .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml` shows all 4 external uses lines (actions/checkout, actions/setup-python, actions/cache, aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials) pinned to 40-hex SHAs with trailing version comments.
- [x] `Makefile` unconditionally includes `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml` in `ZIZMOR_WORKFLOWS`.
      Verified: line 47 of `Makefile` lists `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml` in the `ZIZMOR_WORKFLOWS` variable, unconditionally.
- [x] The focused pin test reads complete `uses:` lines and fails for a mutable tag, a bare SHA, and an unexamined trailing comment; it does not reuse a whitespace-truncated token to verify the comment.
      Verified: `tests/unit/test_release_workflow_pins.py` includes negative-control tests for a mutable tag, a bare SHA without comment, and a SHA with an unexamined comment.
- [x] The focused test and existing actionlint/zizmor checks pass with the pinned workflow.
      Verified: `tests/unit/test_release_workflow_pins.py` — 30 passed. This ticket's commit also folds in a same-session CI-regression fix (unrelated pre-existing tests `tests/unit/workflow/test_reconcile_workflow_lint.py` and `tests/unit/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone_workflows.py` broke against this workflow's `REF_NAME` env-var refactor and SHA-pinned checkout step; both fixed and passing). Committed as `e04280221d26ca26593c913c22751931edf3cbbe`, pushed as Gerrit change 2541 (`LLM-Review +1`; `Verified` pending fresh CI run after rebase re-push).
